scientific_question: On Q032 exact TT common support, can one preregistered native implementation-block intervention remove the Q037/Q038 distributed CamSpec-versus-HiLLiPoP common geometry difference, or is a coupled intervention required?

geometry.sufficiency_rule: matched_median <= 0.10 AND centroid <= 0.10 AND pairwise_median_drift <= 0.10, both full nine-label result and every one of nine leave-one-label-out analyses

relative_calibration_semantics.operation: Disable implementation-native relative calibration freedom at the native neutral value unity while preserving A_planck unchanged and profiled. CamSpec is expected to be a baseline no-op because Q032 TT already fixes relative calibration factors; HiLLiPoP native map calibration factors are fixed to unity. No parameter values are transferred across likelihoods.

quadratic_precision_coupling.operation: After each implementation has constructed its own Q032 exact-support native precision, set only off-diagonal precision elements to zero and preserve its own precision diagonal. This is a matched quadratic-form coupling intervention, not a covariance swap.

foreground_treatment.reason: CamSpec and HiLLiPoP use structurally different native foreground model families. Freezing at each own optimum is nearly tautological; forcing nominal or zero foregrounds is a deliberately misspecified sky model; parameter-by-parameter mapping is forbidden. V1 therefore does not invent a matched foreground equivalence.

core_likelihood_construction.reason: CamSpec coadded-spectrum construction and HiLLiPoP split-map cross-spectrum/weighting construction do not expose a single scientifically equivalent switch at the validated Q032 layer. Deeper reconstruction is outside finite Q039 V1.

coupled_calibration_plus_precision.run_condition: Only if neither preregistered single block is sufficient.

execution.checkpoint_reason: One optimizer restart is an atomic work unit; preserve successful shards and rerun only failed shards.
